name: vb-corpus-production
complexityPolicy: one production parseFile pass per tracked file; the vb analyzer's walk is a single pre-order sweep with containment resolved in one trailing pass, and relationship dedupe is a per-file Set keyed label+target, so the envelope is O(nodes + emitted facts) with no per-symbol rescan of the tree
corpusPolicy: tracked .vb files from a clean p3d@9cf333e6; the whole holding is measured and nothing is excluded, so errorFiles below is the real parse-error profile of a vendored, patched grammar rather than a curated subset
